title: lucille-host --json: verify
description: The release whose code is running passed every check of lucille-host verify: PyPI lists and serves exactly its two files, not yanked, each attested by the publisher named here, and the files installed here are the wheel's.

environment.description: The environment PyPI records every attestation bundle's publisher in.

files.description: The release's two files on PyPI, the wheel then the sdist.

site.description: The folder the running package was imported from, whose files were compared with the wheel's.

installed.description: How many installed files are the wheel's: each file it holds but its RECORD.

bytecode.description: How many bytecode files (.pyc) in the package's __pycache__ folders were counted and not checked.

release_version.description: A final release's version: X.Y.Z, no leading zero, at most nine digits a part.

release_file.description: One of the release's files: its name, the sha256 of the bytes PyPI serves, and how many attestations of it verified.

path.description: An absolute path. A byte of a file name that is not UTF-8 is U+FFFD.
